name: Trevor Hart
story: Trevor Hart worked as a GIS solution architect at Eagle Technology and later helped establish Ope, a specialist ArcGIS Enterprise consultancy. His work has included designing and supporting enterprise GIS platforms for organisations using Esri technology.

Ope's work from 2017 has included ArcGIS Enterprise design, upgrades, health checks and related tools. These services connect system architecture with the practical work of maintaining and improving shared GIS platforms.
